alt: An illustrative Google Drive meeting note, the Google Doc TeamA exported as Markdown, lists organizer Alice, attendee alice c., and a task for Alice Chen; an instructor + LiteLLM extraction and an entity-resolution pass collapse "Alice", "Alice Chen" and "alice c." into one Person, and Neo4j holds Person, Meeting and Task nodes joined by ATTENDED (with is_organizer), DECIDED and ASSIGNED_TO edges; editing the task line re-derives only the Task node and its two edges, and a Cypher query for Alice Chen's tasks returns it.

run.note: Build the graph from your Drive notes
Explore it in Neo4j Browser (neo4j / cocoindex)
